stories.title: 联合国日内瓦会议未就“杀手机器人”自主武器规则达成一致
stories.sourceTitle: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
stories.summary: 联合国日内瓦会议未能就自主武器规则达成一致，代表们仅同意“开始讨论选项”。这值得关注，因为自主武器治理继续拖延，可能让各国和企业按各自标准推进部署。
stories.analysis: 治理真空会放大自主武器部署的不透明性，后续需要看是否有国家推动具有约束力的谈判框架。
stories.sourceExcerpt: One of the items on the agenda for UN diplomats meeting in Geneva this week was working towards rules regarding the use of autonomous weapons, or so-called "killer robots." Eventually, representatives left the meetings agreeing to "start discussing options" af

stories.title: Signal 在 Android 和 iOS 限制截图，称 AI 监控构成“生存威胁”
stories.sourceTitle: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
stories.summary: Signal 限制用户在 Android 和 iOS 应用中截图，以应对 AI 监控带来的风险。隐私通讯应用正尝试从产品层面反制截屏泄露和监控扩张。
stories.analysis: 截图限制只能提高泄露门槛，真正考验的是端到端加密生态、元数据保护和跨平台一致性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.

stories.title: 英伟达的两副面孔：财报强劲与科技高管呼吁黄仁勋回归
stories.sourceTitle: A tale of two Nvidias
stories.summary: TechCrunch 对比英伟达最新财报与科技高管呼吁黄仁勋回归两种叙事，反映市场对英伟达领导层和 AI 算力周期的分歧。
stories.analysis: 财报强不代表生态焦虑消失，领导层叙事可能影响客户、投资者和合作伙伴对英伟达长期节奏的判断。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We got two very different pictures of Nvidia — the company’s latest earnings report vs. the tech executives loudly calling for Jensen Huang’s return.

stories.title: Chess.com 推出经典游戏中心，新增麻将、数独等 10 款游戏
stories.sourceTitle: Chess.com’s next move is a new hub for classic games, from mahjong to sudoku
stories.summary: Chess.com 在 Gambit 扑克站点之后继续扩展，新增双陆棋、跳棋、围棋、麻将、将棋、数独等 10 款游戏。游戏平台正从国际象棋走向多品类休闲游戏。
stories.analysis: 这是 Chess.com 扩张用户时长和订阅变现的关键一步，多品类运营能力比单款棋类更难复制。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Chess.com is ready to go a lot bigger than chess. After launching Gambit, a gambling-free poker site, earlier this year, the company is now adding 10 more games: backgammon, checkers, go, hearts, mahjong, shogi, sudoku, solitaire, xiangqi, and a Scrabble alter

stories.title: Anthropic 上市后还能把安全放在第一位吗？
stories.sourceTitle: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
stories.summary: The Verge 对话 Hayden Field，讨论 Claude 背后的 Anthropic 登陆纳斯达克后的安全投入与商业压力。巨额估值下，安全承诺是否可持续成为关注焦点。
stories.analysis: 上市带来披露和增长压力，安全若不能产品化并形成信任优势，就可能从护城河变成成本中心。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life. The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but n

stories.title: 能在短信里使用的 AI Agent 盘点：覆盖通用助手、家庭、旅行和工作场景
stories.sourceTitle: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
stories.summary: TechCrunch 列出可通过短信交互的 AI Agent，包括通用助理以及面向家庭、旅行和工作的专用代理。消息入口正在成为 AI Agent 的新界面。
stories.analysis: 短信入口能降低安装门槛，但隐私、垃圾信息和平台限制仍是其规模化的关键障碍。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.

stories.title: 演员把 AI 版面孔授权给微短剧公司，这会成为好莱坞的未来吗？
stories.sourceTitle: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
stories.summary: 一名演员向微短剧创业公司授权自己的面部 AI 版本，类似趋势在中国已经流行。专家关注肖像授权对演员长期权益和好莱坞就业的影响。
stories.analysis: 面部授权可能提高内容产能，但必须明确期限、用途和收益分成，否则会侵蚀演员的议价权。
stories.sourceExcerpt: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup — in a trend that's already popular in China. Experts question the long-term consequences if this becomes a trend in Hollywood, too.

stories.title: 特朗普威胁对将 AI 数据中心迁往美国之外的公司征收“巨额税”
stories.sourceTitle: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
stories.summary: 特朗普称将对在美国境外建设数据中心的公司征收“巨额税”，而美国部分州和城市正限制新数据中心申请。AI 基建政策与地方阻力正在正面碰撞。
stories.analysis: 用税收迫使算力留在美国会推高企业选址成本，也可能加剧州层面的审批和政治博弈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them. "We're not going to allow our companies t

stories.title: Outlook 宕机、全国停飞、银行故障：科技系统集体失灵的一周
stories.sourceTitle: The week everything fell apart
stories.summary: The Verge 回顾数天 Outlook 中断、25 年来第二次全国地面停飞、银行和 iCloud 故障。关键数字基础设施的连锁脆弱性再次暴露。
stories.analysis: 单点故障叠加系统依赖，说明韧性建设不能只看云厂商 SLA，还要看跨系统故障隔离能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: There was a dayslong Outlook outage. A nationwide ground stop for only the second time in 25 years. Banks seemed to suddenly stop working. Even iCloud couldn't stay up and running. This week, it felt like the technological world simply collapsed. And it felt l

stories.title: Meta 的 Muse Charm AI 小工具或定价 300 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
stories.summary: The Information 称 Meta 计划将带屏幕、可与 Muse AI Agent 对话的 Muse Charm 定价 300 美元。扎克伯格曾预告该设备，Meta 正把 AI 助手硬件化。
stories.analysis: 300 美元接近主流消费电子价位，关键看它能否比手机语音助手提供不可替代的场景。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm

stories.title: OpenAI 发布对抗“对抗性蒸馏”的分层防护方案
stories.sourceTitle: Combatting adversarial distillation
stories.summary: OpenAI 称通过模型训练、安全措施、检测和执法组合，防止模型能力被提取。模型能力窃取与 API 滥用治理成为焦点。
stories.analysis: 蒸馏攻防是模型护城河的一部分，单靠检测很难根治，需要技术、合同和执法联动。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

stories.title: OpenAI 演示 PR scans：在 Pull Request 流程中查看扫描结果
stories.sourceTitle: See PR scans in action
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布视频，展示 PR scans 的使用方式以及演示者如何在拉取请求工作流中审阅扫描结果。安全扫描正被嵌入开发者日常流程。
stories.analysis: 把扫描嵌入 PR 能减少安全审查摩擦，但误报治理和开发者体验决定实际采用率。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Watch a walkthrough of PR scans and see how the presenter reviews scan results in a pull request workflow.

stories.title: OpenAI 发布 Daybreak Blue 上手指南
stories.sourceTitle: Get started with Daybreak Blue
stories.summary: OpenAI 演示 Daybreak Blue 的入门设置和开始使用流程，重点展示 onboarding 体验。新工具能否从试用转为日常使用，取决于这一环节。
stories.analysis: 引导流程看似基础，却直接影响复杂 AI 产品的激活率和留存。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Watch a walkthrough of onboarding to Daybreak Blue, with a closer look at the setup experience and how to get started.

stories.title: OpenAI 介绍 Daybreak Red 部署参考架构，用于受监督安全调查
stories.sourceTitle: Deploying Daybreak Red
stories.summary: 内容涵盖安全控制、设置和监控，面向受监督的安全调查场景。OpenAI 正在给出安全运营的落地架构参考。
stories.analysis: 参考架构能缩短部署周期，但实际效果取决于日志质量、监控闭环和调查人员的工作流适配。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore a reference architecture for supervised security investigations with Daybreak Red, including safety controls, setup, and monitoring.

stories.title: OpenAI 战略未来负责人 Dean Ball 谈“沉默共识”与 AI 对社会制度的冲击
stories.sourceTitle: The Silent Consensus
stories.summary: Dean Ball 探讨更强 AI 如何重塑社会，以及人们如何保留对机构的控制。前沿实验室正在参与塑造 AI 治理叙事。
stories.analysis: 这类论述会影响政策语言，但需要警惕把制度性问题简化为技术治理问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.

stories.title: 深入 Codex 沙箱：在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上限制文件系统与网络
stories.sourceTitle: Inside the Codex sandbox
stories.summary: OpenAI 展示 Codex 如何在用户机器上执行命令，同时执行用户控制的文件系统和网络限制。编码 Agent 的本地安全边界成为重点。
stories.analysis: 沙箱是 Codex 进入企业环境的前提，跨平台一致性和权限可控性比功能演示更重要。
stories.sourceExcerpt: See how Codex runs commands on your machine while enforcing the filesystem and network limits you control across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

stories.title: OpenAI 模型辅助芯片设计：优化 Jalapeño 硅片电路与 RISC-V 核心
stories.sourceTitle: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
stories.summary: OpenAI 称模型优化了 Jalapeño 硅片所用电路，并改进 RISC-V 核心设计，展示 GPT-6 Astra 在 AI 辅助芯片设计上的进展。
stories.analysis: 芯片设计是高风险长周期场景，AI 提效最终要靠流片结果和可复现工程指标证明。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT‑6 Astra.

stories.title: OpenAI 推出 Astra for Law，称在 24 个法律领域评测中排名第一
stories.sourceTitle: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence
stories.summary: Astra for Law 在覆盖 24 个法律领域的发布评测中排名第一，ChatGPT Enterprise 客户可申请访问。法律行业专用 AI 竞争正在升温。
stories.analysis: 法律场景重准确与可追溯，排行榜之外还需验证律所工作流适配和责任边界。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Astra for Law ranked first in a launch evaluation spanning 24 areas of law. Every ChatGPT Enterprise customer can now request access.

stories.title: OpenAI 与智利政府合作推出 OpenAI for Chile
stories.sourceTitle: Introducing OpenAI for Chile
stories.summary: 双方将支持负责任 AI 采用、建设公共部门技能，并帮助本地初创企业开发 AI 应用。国家级 AI 合作模式再添一例。
stories.analysis: 政府合作能加速公共部门采用，但数据主权、采购透明度和本地能力建设仍是落地关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI and the Government of Chile are partnering to support responsible AI adoption, build public-sector skills and help local startups develop AI applications.

stories.title: LVMH 媒体部门与 OpenAI 合作，用 AI 支持新闻业并让出版物通过 ChatGPT 更易获取
stories.sourceTitle: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
stories.summary: LVMH 媒体部门与 OpenAI 建立战略合作，支持新闻业使用 AI，并让其出版物在 ChatGPT 中更易访问。媒体内容与 AI 平台的分发合作进一步深化。
stories.analysis: 内容方与模型平台直接合作，可能重塑流量入口和版权补偿谈判，但内容控制权仍是核心争议。
stories.sourceExcerpt: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through ChatGPT.

stories.title: OpenAI 启动首阶段嵌入式评估，联合 Apollo Research、METR 等独立评估模型对齐与监控
stories.sourceTitle: Our first phase of embedded assessments
stories.summary: OpenAI 与 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce 和 Goodfire 开展嵌入式评估，独立审查模型对齐、安全措施和监控系统。第三方评估机制进入实操阶段。
stories.analysis: 嵌入式评估提高透明度，但评估范围、方法披露和问题整改机制决定其公信力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, and Transluce, and Goodfire to independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards, and monitoring systems.

stories.title: Google Labs 推出 Tabletop：可定制的群组协作空间，用于规划、娱乐和共同做事
stories.sourceTitle: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.
stories.summary: Tabletop 是 Google Labs 的新实验，支持团队创建互动行程、投票和对阵表，并可加入等待名单。AI 协作正从个人助手延伸到群组场景。
stories.analysis: 群组协作是 AI 助手走向社交场景的切口，但多人权限、实时同步和隐私边界决定体验上限。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tabletop is a new Google Labs experiment for group collaboration. Build interactive itineraries, polls, and brackets with your team. Join the waitlist.

stories.title: Holiday Extras 用 dots 让 AI 主动生成发布报告、标记问题并准备通勤会议
stories.sourceTitle: At Holiday Extras, dots get to work before anyone asks
stories.summary: 在 Holiday Extras，dots 会未经提示生成发布报告、标记人们可能忽略的问题，并在通勤时讨论即将到来的会议。主动式 AI 工作流成为案例重点。
stories.analysis: 主动式 Agent 的价值在于减少“提问成本”，但误报和打扰控制决定员工是否愿意长期使用。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Dots deliver launch reports unprompted, flag issues people might miss, and talk through upcoming meetings on the commute to work.

stories.title: OpenAI 用 GPT-6 Astra 推进格点上的标准模型定义
stories.sourceTitle: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
stories.summary: OpenAI 探讨标准模型的非微扰格点定义候选方案，并称 GPT-6 Astra 帮助将想法转化为详细证明。AI 辅助理论物理再进一步。
stories.analysis: 若证明能被同行验证，这会是 AI 参与基础科学的强信号，否则仍只是案例宣传。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model and how GPT-6 Astra helped turn the idea into a detailed proof.

stories.title: OpenAI 推出科学博客，分享 AI 推动科学发现的研究与实践
stories.sourceTitle: Our new blog for science
stories.summary: 新博客将发布研究发现、实用方法，以及研究人员使用 AI 推动科学发现的一手叙述。OpenAI 正加强对科学社区的生态投入。
stories.analysis: 这是人才与生态建设，能否持续输出可复现方法比品牌内容更重要。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The OpenAI science blog shares new findings, practical methods, and firsthand accounts from researchers using AI to advance scientific discovery.

stories.title: 亚马逊云科技推出 TorchNeuron，PyTorch 模型无需修改即可在 AWS Trainium 运行
stories.sourceTitle: 亚马逊云科技推出 TorchNeuron，可以直接在 AWS Trainium 上运行 PyTorch 模型，无需任何修改
stories.summary: TorchNeuron 让 PyTorch 模型可直接在 AWS Trainium 上运行，且无需修改代码。自研 AI 芯片的迁移门槛进一步降低。
stories.analysis: 减少改写成本是 Trainium 争夺 PyTorch 开发者的关键，性能、算子覆盖和调试体验仍需验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: GPT-6.2 Astra 在 16 项具身任务上成功率较 GPT-6 Astra 翻倍，并实现可变形物体操控全球首通
stories.sourceTitle: GPT-6.2 Astra再次暴击具身模型：16项任务成功率较GPT-6 Astra翻倍
stories.summary: 量子位称 GPT-6.2 Astra 在 16 项具身任务上成功率翻倍，还实现可变形物体操控全球首通。模型能力向机器人操作迁移值得关注。
stories.analysis: 成功率翻倍若可复现，将说明通用模型对具身任务的迁移增强，但真实机器人泛化仍是硬指标。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 还实现可变形物体操控全球首通

stories.title: Qwen 推出 Qwen3Guard：面向 Token 流的实时安全护栏模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen3Guard 基于 Qwen3 基础模型微调，是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，用于实时安全分类。开源模型安全治理工具再添新选项。
stories.analysis: 把安全分类做成实时护栏有助于应用落地，但策略可配置性和误杀率决定其可用性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech Report GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope DISCORD Introduction We are excited to introduce Qwen3Guard, the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. Built upon the powerful Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned specifically for safety classificatoin,
